a.xlink:title: Quotes an atom as one POSIX shell or Windows PowerShell literal, without interpolation.

Runs the CLI using an owned directory and separate UTF-8 output files, returning only after cleanup. An element of ``Arguments`` is an atom or a list of atoms to be concatenated; the atom ``$input`` is replaced by the path of the problem file (appended as the last argument if no element refers to it) and the atom ``$solution`` by the path of a file in the owned directory that the solver can write its solution to. ``Solution`` is the contents of that file (an empty list if the solver did not write it).
